plan.method: Editable projected 2D polygons, ovals and curtainwall grids. World geometry in centimetres at scale 1; orthographic elevated three-quarter azimuth 35°, elevation 28°. Overall height verified at 508m; local widths, tier elevations and ornaments estimated from published appearance, not construction documents. No surroundings or labels.

whole.requirement: Entire Taipei 101 from base to spire; distinctive silhouette in an elevated three-quarter view.
whole.description: All eight flared tiers, tapering base and complete crown/spire visible; roof surfaces and consistent projection; no unrelated additions.

detail.requirement: Highly detailed realistic architecture without schematic simplification.
detail.description: Native windows, frames, setbacks, visible ornamentation, entry, crown and spire detail.

materials.description: Green-blue reflective glazing, differentiated lit/shadow facades, metallic trim and recess shadows.

scale.requirement: Real-world dimensions at 1 cm = 1 px before projection; projected lengths reflect viewing angle.
scale.description: 50800 cm total world height, unit projection scale; local dimensions explicitly estimated where unpublished.

editable.description: Native editable vector/window/frame components, not raster artwork.

sources: Architect project height 508m, eight eight-floor tiers and ornament descriptions
assumptions: Base width63m, upper flare50m, tier pitch35m; dimensional reconstruction from appearance rather than measured drawings.
